name: 8 Out of 10 Cats
overview: A weekly, topical panel show based around a huge series of opinion poll surveys carried out around Britain.

seasons.name: Series 1
seasons.overview: Jimmy Carr hosts a panel show about opinions, surveys and statistics, with team captains Sean Lock and Dave Spikey.

seasons.name: Series 2
seasons.overview: Jimmy Carr hosts the stat-happy comedy panel show where teams of fearless, hard-hitting celebrity analysts compete to see who best understands what's really going on in Britain.

seasons.name: Series 4
seasons.overview: What is Britain's most unwanted wedding gift - and who would the British public most like to have round for dinner? Jimmy Carr and team captains Sean Lock and Dave Spikey star in the comedy panel show that provides the answers to these burning questions.

seasons.name: Series 5
seasons.overview: Jimmy Carr and veteran team captain Sean Lock are joined by a new team captain, Jason Manford, in the fourth series of the irreverent, irrelevent and highly irregular panel show.

seasons.name: Series 6
seasons.overview: Jimmy Carr hosts the proceedings as team captains Sean Lock and Jason Manford battle it out to decide who has the best grasp on the essential issues of the day in a series of largely pointless - but highly entertaining - studio debates.

seasons.name: Series 7
seasons.overview: The irreverent, irrelevant and revealing topical comedy panel show. Jimmy Carr hosts proceedings, Sean Lock and Jason Manford are the team captains.

seasons.name: Series 8
seasons.overview: Back for the eighth series, Jimmy Carr hosts proceedings as team captains Sean Lock and Jason Manford battle it out to discover who knows what is going on in Britain today.

seasons.name: Series 9
seasons.overview: It's back for an incredible ninth series. The cheeky comedy panel series sets out to predict and analyse what the almighty British public thinks about the week's most discussed subjects. Jimmy Carr takes the centre chair and is joined by witty team captains Sean Lock and Jason Manford.

seasons.name: Series 10
seasons.overview:
8 Out of 10 Cats returns this autumn to bring debate, dispute and deliberation to the hot topics that are getting the almighty British public's chins wagging.

As ever, presenter and stand-up comic Jimmy Carr plays host, joined by team captains Sean Lock and Jason Manford. Alongside them are panellists from the world of comedy, entertainment and showbiz, as well as a few surprise guests.

Teams thrash out the topics of the week by examining surveys, opinion polls and statistics; discussing both silly and serious stuff, with subjects ranging from showbiz and gossip to world politics and even the weather.

seasons.name: Series 11
seasons.overview:
8 Out of 10 Cats returns for its 11th series, and joining Jimmy Carr and Sean Lock is new team captain Jon Richardson.

Together they thrash out the hot topics of the week by examining surveys, opinion polls and statistics - from the silly to the serious, from celebrity gossip to world politics.

seasons.name: Series 12
seasons.overview: Channel 4's ever popular comedy panel show returns for a 12th series, including its 100th episode. Stand up comic and presenter Jimmy Carr is back to oversee disputes and deliberations on topical events that have set the chins of the great British public wagging.

seasons.name: Series 13
seasons.overview: Host Jimmy Carr and team captains Sean Lock and Jon Richardson return for a brand new series of the topical comedy panel show that dives into the world of polls, surveys and statistics in its own unique way.

seasons.name: Series 14
seasons.overview: Host Jimmy Carr is once again joined by team captains Sean Lock and Jon Richardson as they discuss the topical events that set the great British public's chins wagging. Sean and Jon are joined in their quest to uncover the public's most popular taking points by famous faces from the world of comedy, entertainment and showbiz.

seasons.name: Series 15
seasons.overview: Host Jimmy Carr and team captains Sean Lock and Jon Richardson are back for a new series of the topical comedy panel show that dives into the world of polls, surveys and statistics in its own unique way. With an array of celebrity guests who join the panel for each edition.
